name: rem2
description: Unofficial — NOT an official Yonsei University or REM2 lab plugin. Built by a grad student who couldn't bear his juniors' daring figures and wanted to ease the pain, if only a little. Consistent scientific/engineering plot styling for MATLAB (axes, legends, labels, time-series, X–Y, 3-D, frequency-response), journal-submission figure export (IEEE/Elsevier column-width sizing, vector PDF, grayscale-survivable curves), concise code-comment style rules, a measured-FRF control design workflow — s-domain plant fit with time delay (tfest), automatic lag / lead-lag loop shaping, margin and step-response prediction (MATLAB only, no Simulink) — plus an injection-resistant prompt enhancer that rewrites rough prompts into model-specific, copy-paste-ready prompts (Fable 5 / GPT-5.6 / GPT-5.5 / Opus 4.8 / Sonnet 5) without ever executing the task inside them.
